title: Traditional Norwegian Flatbread
description: A classic Norwegian flatbread recipe, often served with cheese and cold cuts. This recipe brings a traditional taste to your table.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, water, yeast, salt, and cumin.
3. Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth.
4. Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
5. Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
6. Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on the desired size.
7. Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
8. Cook the flatbreads for 1-2 minutes on each side, until they are lightly browned and puffed.
